About Us - Globality

# Redefining how enterprises source. 

 

Glo 2.0 is the autonomous sourcing platform that manages the complete intake-to-award process.

Our sourcing platform autonomously interprets purchase intent, generates RFx materials, determines suitable suppliers, and executes negotiation strategies that produce high-quality award decisions, managing the full process from intake to award.

We deliver 60-90% faster sourcing cycle times and 10-20% cost savings annually for leading enterprises including BT, Tesco, Swiss Re, Deloitte, UPS, Fidelity, Bristol Myers Squibb, Société Générale, and HP.

## Executive Team 

 

 Jared Hyatt Chief Executive Officer 

Jared is CEO of Globality. Before that, he led Globality’s finance functions. He was previously an investor at Norwest Venture Partners, where he focused on early-stage technology. Earlier in his career, he worked at established technology companies, including Google and Apple, and at successful startups such as VideoSurf (acquired by Microsoft).

 

 Vinod Devan President, Go-To-Market 

Vinod leads Globality’s commercial organization and growth strategy. He previously led go-to-market teams through periods of rapid scaling at Confluent and Cohere, including Confluent’s IPO. Prior to that, he served as a Partner at Deloitte, guiding leadership teams through major business transformations.

 

 Sonia Mathai Chief Human Resources Officer 

Sonia is passionate about fostering a mission-driven, inclusive culture where all employees can do their best work. Prior to joining Globality, she built and scaled global recruiting and human resources functions at Synack and Upwork. Sonia has been recognized multiple times in Diversity Journal’s Women Worth Watching in Leadership Awards and is a recipient of the Ragan Award which highlights her work supporting women in technology, encouraging a positive workplace environment, and focusing on employee wellness.

 

 Keith McFarlane Chief Technology Officer 

A software applications veteran with over 25 years of experience, Keith has a passion for building applications and organizations that perform and scale. From his early days with AT&T Bell Laboratories to his years building out the Oracle Service Cloud, Keith has run and grown diverse, open, and collaborative teams and organizations that continuously innovate while producing applications of the highest quality.

## Board Members 

 

 Joel Hyatt Co-Founder & Chairman 

Joel is a serial entrepreneur who has launched and scaled several disruptive service companies. He co-founded and served as CEO of Globality, Hyatt Legal Services, Hyatt Legal Plans (acquired by MetLife), and Current TV (acquired by Al Jazeera). He now focuses on his role as Chairman of the Board of Globality.

 

 Lior Delgo Co-Founder & Vice Chairman 

Lior is a serial entrepreneur with a proven record of building disruptive technology and new business models. He is Co-Founder and Vice Chairman of Globality, where he pioneered the use of AI to transform enterprise sourcing and procurement. He previously co-founded and served as CEO of FareChase (acquired by Yahoo) and VideoSurf (acquired by Microsoft). After the VideoSurf acquisition, he stayed at Microsoft as a Partner and Group Program Manager at Xbox. Lior holds numerous technology patents.

# Globality

Globality is a Software Development company. Globality is the leader in autonomous sourcing, using sophisticated AI, creating precisely scoped requirements, identifying the most qualified suppliers, providing negotiation insights, and enables data-driven decisions. Globality employs 101 people (+8.6% YoY, +8 people) and has an annual revenue of $80M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across United States, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Romania.

## About

Globality has always been dedicated to one goal: helping procurement teams unlock more savings and more value. Glo is the first truly autonomous sourcing platform that manages the complete intake-to-award process for all spend types, from strategic to tail. 

We built the platform with deep domain expertise gained from working alongside HP, Bristol Myers Squibb, BT, PPG, Tesco, Swiss Re, Fidelity, Société Générale, Humana, UPS, and other global enterprises. 

Learn how Globality delivers 10-20% annual cost savings at https://www.globality.com/
